errors.text_span: Линията за ЕС (черна пунктирана) започва около 22% през 2000 г., спада леко до около 20% около 2005 г., след което остава сравнително стабилна около 20% до 2015 г., а после започва да се увеличава, достигайки около 25% през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns the data trend for Japan (the top line, starting at ~22%) to the EU. The actual line for the EU is the dashed line at the bottom of the chart, starting at 5%. Additionally, it misidentifies the line style for the EU as 'черна пунктирана' (black dotted) when it is dashed.

errors.text_span: Линията за Япония (черна с точка и тире) започва около 22% през 2000 г., спада леко до около 20% около 2005 г., след това остава стабилна около 20% до 2010 г., и след това започва да се увеличава, достигайки около 25% през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: This description of the trend for Japan is a near-verbatim repetition of the description already incorrectly used for the EU. This creates a confusing and contradictory description, as the same data trend is attributed to two different entities.

errors.text_span: и след това остава стабилна между 2 и 3% до 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The description for Bulgaria's trend is incorrect. After 2010, the line does not remain stable between 2% and 3%; instead, it shows a clear and steady increase, rising from approximately 3% in 2010 to over 6% by 2018.

errors.text_span: докато линията за България остава на ниско ниво с минимални колебания.
errors.evidence: This summary statement incorrectly characterizes the trend for Bulgaria. While the values are low compared to other series, the relative increase from ~2% to over 6% (a tripling of the value) cannot be described as 'minimal fluctuations'. The line shows a significant upward trend after 2010.
The description states the period is until 2018, likely taken from the figure caption. However, the chart's x-axis extends to 2020 and the data lines continue past 2018, up to approximately 2019.
The phrase 'сиво-сиво-сива плътна' (grey-grey-grey solid) is unnecessarily repetitive and awkward. 'Сива плътна' (solid grey) would be sufficient and clearer.
